text:
sam: Nimbus wants a 3-week POC: streaming + function/tool calls to populate structured claim fields. Need a one-page runbook, security checklist for SOC2, and a headline reserved-pricing note.

jenna: Stack: Node frontend, Python workers, tiny Go adapter?

sam: Yes.

miguel: Quick Node snippet for streaming + function_call + structured JSON:
```js
const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-large-v2',stream:true,structured_output:true,tools:[{name:'extract_claim'}]});
s.on('function_call', async (c)=>{const r=await fetch('/adapter/extract',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({text:c.args.text})});await s.resume({tool_result:await r.json()});});
```
Use SSE for simple UI progress, websockets for low-latency two-way.

devon: Ops defaults for POC: batch_size=1, max_concurrency=4, prefix_kv_cache=true; enable fallback to smaller-model; use quantized variant for lower latency if acceptable.

priya: For SOC2: I need customer security contact, sample payloads, retention requirement, and whether PII will be sent to hosted API. Recommend Redwood Private if they send PII.

elaine: Pricing sketch: 3-week small reserved bucket ~$6k + overage; one-time 20% POC discount subject to deal-desk. Longer log retention is add-on.

sam: Action list: Jenna -> Postman + examples; Miguel -> final Node/Python snippets; Devon -> ops runbook; Priya -> prefilled security Q; Elaine -> pricing/SOW blurb. Target: customer email in 24h.

redwood-bot: Tag #poc-handovers when assets ready for sales-ops pickup.
